prompt_summary: Edit the approved GINA phone/tablet notebook reference with high fidelity. Preserve original mint plush mascot and gina logo, cream grid paper, purple controls, typography and warm soft borders. Tablet question panel approximately 35%, notebook 65%; retain question image first, given-value add chips, large reading mascot with speech bubble, compact single-row lilac toolbar, saved badge and small navigation. Add a discreet expand control. Phone retains deep-purple selected notebook tab, compact question thumbnail with collapse control, single-row toolbar, large notebook and small saved/next controls. No permanent color row or helper-text row; no new branding or art direction. Triangle AB=6, BC=8, AC=10 and handwritten 6+8+10=24 cm are illustrative sample content, not a production asset.

All touch targets remain at least 48 dp; compact visuals do not reduce hit areas.
Shared-source label appears only if real shared-question data exists.
Handwriting shown is example student content, never a fixed answer image in the shipped UI.
Keep existing editable ink and answer revision protections.
After visual approval: implement, capture phone/tablet, validate and submit TestFlight; continue backlog afterward.
